name: Kael Voss
title: Grid Ghost
description: A skinny paddock striker in a black-and-teal racing jacket. He fights like a late-braking overtake: wait, then vanish down the inside.
source_description: Male fighter, skinny lean build, curly brown hair, black teal white racing jacket, aggressive personality, formula racing speed powers.
special_desc: Drops into an invisible tow and flashes through the opponent like a last-lap overtake.
ultimate_desc: Five red lights... then a full-lane launch that hits like a start-grid explosion.
